authority: Lead explicit completion-semantics request in current session; zero length is already within SPEC binary layout

semantics.zeroLength: trusted terminal, contributes zero raw bytes
semantics.native: exactly one terminal per started phase/channel after all payload and before NATIVE_END; no completion marker after cap/failed flush
semantics.observer: exactly one terminal per eligible body ordinal after all payload and before REQUEST; an empty body consists only of its terminal
semantics.decoder: decodeRawFrames validates the entire supplied buffer, includes empty terminal records in returned ABI-shaped array, rejects missing/duplicate terminals and any later payload on closed channel/ordinal
semantics.host: incremental decoding must join both native channel terminals with actual NATIVE_END before classifying phase output; join body terminal with REQUEST/RESPONSE before proof; neither cross-pipe arrival order nor write callback alone proves join

hashConventions.stdinSha256: SHA(raw input); empty version input, literal port input
